The '''ring''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in the possession of [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]. It was recovered from the [[Kin's Storeroom]] in the [[Rahad]] district of [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|8|4}}

==Appearance==
The ring is average sized and possesses a round, pale green stone.

==Use==
When either ''[[saidar]]'' or ''[[saidin]]'' is being channeled within a certain distance, the ring will appear to vibrate differently to signal either one, though it does not actually move.{{ref/book|11|27}}
